title: Book Gen Workflow
description: Interactive simulation for Book Gen Workflow
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Book
learningObjectives: Trace the primary path of the textbook pipeline from Course Description through Concept Enumeration and Concept Dependencies to the Learning Graph
Explain why the Learning Graph must precede book-level artifacts such as Chapters and Sections, the Glossary, the FAQ, and the Concept Taxonomy
Distinguish book-level outputs (Glossary, Word Cloud, FAQ, Summaries) from chapter-level outputs (Figures, Interactive Infographics, MicroSims, Graphic Novel Stories, Assessments)
Identify the role of the 2001 Bloom Taxonomy as an input that shapes concept enumeration and assessment generation
Describe the dependency arrows that connect each workflow step by hovering to reveal that step's detailed description
